runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt:
The section file sections/blog-posts-showcase.liquid renders a list of recent blog articles. Its markup is correct and must not be changed, but its {% schema %} JSON is out of date: the heading size select the markup reads is missing, the post limit range is wrong, an author default is wrong, there is no settings group header, and the section can currently be added to header/footer groups. Replace the schema JSON so it is exactly this:

Top-level keys:
- name: "Blog posts"
- tag: "section"
- class: "section-blog-posts"
- disabled_on: an object with key groups whose value is the array ["header", "footer"] (in that order)

settings (exactly these, in this order):
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Blog posts"
2. type "select", id "heading_size", label "Heading size", options in this order: value "h2" label "Small"; value "h1" label "Medium"; value "h0" label "Large"; default "h1"
3. type "blog", id "blog", label "Blog" (no default)
4. type "range", id "post_limit", label "Number of posts to show", min 2, max 4, step 1, default 3 (numbers)
5. type "range", id "columns_desktop", label "Columns on desktop", min 1, max 4, step 1, default 3 (numbers)
6. type "header", content "Post details"
7. type "checkbox", id "show_image", label "Show featured image", default true
8. type "checkbox", id "show_date", label "Show date", default true
9. type "checkbox", id "show_author", label "Show author", default false
10. type "checkbox", id "show_view_all", label "Show view all button", default true

Checkbox defaults are JSON booleans, not strings.

No blocks key. presets: exactly one preset with only name "Blog posts".

No other keys anywhere in the schema. Change only sections/blog-posts-showcase.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
